translations.This app provides a backend and frontend: This app provides a backend and frontend for the notification API available in datadrive.vn.

This app provides a backend and frontend for the notification API available in datadrive.vn.
		The API is used by other apps to notify users in the web UI and sync clients about various things. Some examples are:

📬 Federated file sharing: You received a new remote share

📑 Comments: Another user mentioned you in a comment on a file

🚢 Update notification: Available update for an app or nextcloud itself

📣 Announcement center: An announcement was posted by an admin
translations.We want to keep offering our push notifi: We want to keep offering our push notification service for free, but large number of users overload our infrastructure. For this reason we have to rate-limit the use of push notifications. If you need this feature, consider using Enterprise.
